title: Revision exam-style question set (lesson 73)
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Seeded from mathematics/y11 lesson 73 (Revision exam-style question set (portal worksheet written for this lesson; original questions with mark-scheme answers))
intro: Lesson 73: Mock review: mark schemes, common errors and repair lists. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Repair 3: Solve 4x² − 7x − 1 = 0, giving answers to 2 d.p.
Write your personal repair list: three topics, the mark lost, the fix and the date you will practise each (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: '1. Quadratic inequalities, 2 marks, sketch first, practise 20 Mar; 2. ...'

questions.q: Repair 1: After a 12% increase a price is £84. Find the original.
Repair 2: Find the line perpendicular to y = 3x + 1 through (3, 2).
Name your top repair topic and the first thing you will do.
questions.a: For example: 'Bounds: learn the max/min table and do 5 questions on Monday.'
